To: Acme Corp <acme-sales@acme.com>, Orbit AI <platform@orbitai.io>, Sara Liu <sara@northwind.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Evening engagement: consolidated group walkthrough + presenter rotation

Hi all —

Thanks for signing up for the group walkthrough. We have a handful of customers who indicated evening availability and I want to consolidate into a single 75-minute session that covers: an intro to Redwood inference runtime, deployment options, and a short live Q&A. Proposed plan below.

Agenda (75 min)
- 0-10m: quick intros + goals
- 10-30m: serving runtime + routing policies (Marissa)
- 30-50m: dedicated/private deployments + cost levers (Soojin)
- 50-65m: demo: live inference run & tracing (Rishi)
- 65-75m: open Q&A / next steps

Presenter rotation: we propose Marissa -> Soojin -> Rishi to tighten handoffs. If anyone can't do their segment, flag it here and we'll swap.

Proposed windows (pick one):
- Option A: Wed Jun 30, 18:00-19:15 PT (convenient for NA evening)
- Option B: Thu Jul 1, 20:00-21:15 PT (more APAC-friendly later)

Attachments:
- agenda.pdf (PDF)
- slides-v1.pptx (PPTX)

Ask: please reply with preferred option and any scheduling constraints by EOD today so I can send a final calendar invite and localized dial-in details.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: agenda.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks — quick notes inline.

- Good to consolidate. Orbit AI mentioned earlier they have APAC participants who would struggle at 18:00 PT; Option B looks safer for them.
- For the demo portion I can take the cost/levers segment but would prefer to swap ordering: Marissa -> Rishi -> Soojin. That way Rishi's demo sets up the cost conversation and we end on Q&A.

If we pick Option B I can prep the private deployment slides with an extra slide on autoscaling burst behavior — will attach a short addendum.

On timezone logistics: can we include an alternate dial-in for Singapore attendees and add a 10-minute buffer at the end for follow-ups?

On the attachments, I like the agenda but can we mark which slides are sensitive (customer-specific screenshots) so we can omit them from the recording?

Thanks — Soojin
